command: cd /workspace; ls -la; cat mcp.json | sed 's/\(token\|Bearer\)[^"]*/\1 [redacted]/Ig'; which mcpjam; npx --no-install @mcpjam/cli --help 2>&1 | head -30

cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s -i -X POST http://fixture:8765/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"t","version":"1"}}}' | head -20
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -i -E 'cli|command' | head; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/getting-started.md | head -60
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/server-inspection.md | head -70; npm view @mcpjam/cli version 2>&1 | tail -2

cd /workspace; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --rpc --out doctor.json 2>&1 | head -40; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest server doctor --help 2>&1 | grep -i -E 'token|header'

cd /workspace; C="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $C tools call --help 2>&1 | grep -E '^\s+--(tool|name|params|args)|Usage'; for p in '{"a":2,"b":3}' '{"a":"x"}'; do echo "== $p"; $C tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --tool-name add --tool-args "$p" 2>&1 | head -c 800; echo; done

cd /workspace; cat > validate.sh <<'E'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: MCP_SERVER_TOKEN=[REDACTED] ./validate.sh
C="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; U=http://fixture:8765/mcp
$C server doctor --url $U --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --out doctor.json >/dev/null
$C tools call --url $U --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --name add --params '{"a":2,"b":3}'
$C tools call --url $U --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --name add --params '{"a":"x"}'
E
chmod +x validate.sh
